_comment: Editorial content for BECO. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Beco Steel Limited, formerly Ravi Textile Mills Limited, took its present name in 2021 after a reverse merger brought two melting units and one re-rolling unit into the listed company. It manufactures steel and allied products at Badami Bagh, Lahore, and is led by a third-generation steel manufacturing family whose business began in 1962.
sourceNote: Company website (becosteel.com: who we are, products, contact) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/BECO: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
